description:
Starts chasing Clients for their records for a Quarter: each gets a personal link (no login, works on a phone) and a first email; then Nudges go out on the practice's plan until they send their records. confirm:false (default) shows who would be chased, who has no email, the checklist and the dates (the date Clients are asked to send by, and the HMRC deadline); confirm:true starts it. Safe to repeat: Clients already being chased are left alone.
Use this when: asking Clients to send their records for a Quarter — everyone, a group by tag, or one Client — including particular items such as bank statements or receipts (checklist).
Not for: reminding Clients already being chased (send_nudges_now); documents unrelated to the quarterly update.

checklist.description: what to send, 1–8 items; default: the practice's checklist (sales and income, receipts and invoices for expenses, bank statements for accounts the practice can't already see)

confirm.description: false (default) = dry run: shows what would happen, changes nothing. true = do it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional; reuse when retrying so the change happens once.

quarter.description: Quarter like "2026-27 Q3". Default: the Quarter whose HMRC deadline is next.

name: start_chase
title: Chase a Quarter
